mapper.insert: insert into user_daily_challenge ( user_id, game_type, challenge_date, region_id, start_at, clear_at, source, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{gameType, jdbcType=INTEGER, typeHandler=com.sniper.game.wordgame.typehandler.GameTypeEnumTypeHandler}, #{challengeDate}, #{regionId}, #{startAt}, #{clearAt}, #{source, jdbcType=INTEGER, typeHandler=com.sniper.game.wordgame.typehandler.SourceEnumTypeHandler}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: SELECT region_id AS regionId, COUNT(*) AS clearCount, 0 AS `rank`, 0 AS isMe FROM user_daily_challenge WHERE game_type = #{gameType, jdbcType=INTEGER, typeHandler=com.sniper.game.wordgame.typehandler.GameTypeEnumTypeHandler} AND challenge_date = #{challengeDate} AND region_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region_id ORDER BY clearCount DESC, region_id
